items.text: Leaving a job, or is your COBRA running out? Losing job-based coverage usually opens a 60-day window to enroll in a Marketplace plan, and you may qualify for a tax credit based on household income. COBRA keeps your same plan, but you usually pay the full cost. We compare both side by side. HealthCare.gov enrollment runs through Jan 15; state-run exchanges may set different dates. Call (571) 354-0146.
